channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Hyderabad to Host World’s First Beauty-Tech GCC as L’Oréal Announces Major Investment
item.description: The Telangana Rising delegation, led by Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, secured a landmark investment from global cosmetics giant L’Oréal, marking the establishment of the world’s first beauty-tech Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Hyderabad.

item.title: Mamata Govt Issues Fresh Instructions to DMs on Electoral Roll Revision
item.description: Amid the ongoing tussle between the West Bengal government and the Election Commission of India (ECI) on the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in the state, the Mamata government has issued certain directions to the District Magistrates (DMs), who are also the District Electoral Officers (DEOs).

item.title: Tie-up talks intensify in TN as NDA alliance trying to expand front ahead of PM’s visit tomorrow
item.description: With the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections likely to be held in April this year, political activity in the State has entered a decisive phase and intense discussions are currently underway to consolidate the AIADMK–BJP alliance.

item.title: ICC chair Jay Shah meets Africa Cricket Association leaders in Windhoek; attends U19 WC match
item.description: International Cricket Council (ICC) chair Jay Shah met with leaders of the Africa Cricket Association in Windhoek and emphasised the ICC's commitment to expanding cricket across Africa.

item.title: CJM who ordered FIR against policemen in Sambhal violence, among 14 judicial officers transferred by Allahabad High Court
item.description: In a significant administrative reshuffle, the Allahabad High Court has ordered the transfer of 14 judicial officers, including Sambhal Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM) Vibhanshu Sudheer.

item.title: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat on 2-day Jaipur tour from today
item.description: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh Sarsanghchalak Mohan Bhagwat will be on a two-day visit to Jaipur in Rajasthan starting from Wednesday.

item.title: Internal consultations in BJP underway in Delhi under new chief Nitin Nabin
item.description: The newly appointed BJP National President Nitin Nabin has convened an important organisational meeting at the party headquarters in New Delhi on Wednesday for the first time after assuming office and internal consultations in the party are underway.

item.title: ECI hosts IICDEM 2026 global meet on democracy today
item.description: he Election Commission of India (ECI) is hosting the India International Conference on Democracy and Election Management (IICDEM) 2026 starting Wednesday. The three-day conference is set to become the largest global gathering of its kind ever hosted by India in the field of democracy and election management.

item.title: ED raids rock Devaswom Board in Sabarimala gold heist case, CPI(M) on the defensive
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate’s late-night raids across three states have marked a significant escalation in the Sabarimala gold heist probe, with the central agency for the first time entering the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) headquarters and seizing key records.

item.title: ‘Emraan Hashmi Creates a Very Relaxed Environment’: Nitin Rao
item.description: Actor Nitin Rao, who got to star alongside Emraan Hashmi in the latest release Taskaree, has heaped praise on the Bollywood star and said that despite being such a senior actor, he never made him feel that hierarchy on set.
